classes.A_STRONG_CANDIDATE: high ArtMatch + rotation OK + positive predecessor prior
classes.B_PHYSICAL_CANDIDATE: high ArtMatch + rotation OK + predecessor neutral/negative/unknown
classes.C_ROTATION_CAUTION: high ArtMatch + observed recent target pea/other pea/faba within 6-year caution scenario
classes.D_NOT_HIGH_PHYSICAL_MATCH: ArtMatch below top-20-percent product threshold or insufficient core

guardrails: ÄrtMatch v0a is frozen and read-only
top-20-percent ArtMatch is a transparent MVP product threshold, not a biological cutoff
rotation uses observed 2015-2025 history and is left-censored
other pea and faba are cautions, not proven equivalent rotation constraints
predecessor prior is historical selection association, not causal agronomic effect
processor distance, logistics, contracts, irrigation and water risk are intentionally excluded from C8
A-class predecessor prior requires at least 50 historical positive predecessor events in C8b
